candidate_mechanical_states.note: These are prospectively frozen mechanical evidence states. They do not mutate the formal candidate disposition in v080.

rules.MECHANICALLY_EXPLAINED_RECURRENT_SKY_SOU: at least two distinct physical comparison plates have PRIMARY-registered strict native recurrence
rules.ONE_INDEPENDENT_NATIVE_RECURRENCE_RETAIN: exactly one distinct physical comparison plate has PRIMARY-registered strict recurrence
rules.TRANSIENT_LIKE_NATIVE_NONRECURRENCE_SUPP: zero strict native recurrences and at least two distinct physical comparison plates are sensitivity-qualified negatives
rules.UNRESOLVED_NATIVE_SENSITIVITY_INSUFFICIE: zero strict native recurrences and fewer than two distinct sensitivity-qualified negatives

epoch_priority: midpoint of DATE-OBS and DATE-END when both parseable
comparison_scan_epoch_and_wcs.hdu: primary HDU; v080 preflight demonstrated one HDU for all 53 scans
comparison_scan_epoch_and_wcs.no_wcs: operational row hold; never interpreted as recurrence or nondetection
comparison_scan_epoch_and_wcs.preflight_fact: 53/53 acquired scans have a FITS-header celestial WCS
comparison_scan_epoch_and_wcs.wcs_choice: use primary unsuffixed celestial WCS when available, otherwise the lexicographically first usable alternate celestial WCS

execution.operational_failure_policy: continue independent rows, preserve exact failures, and finish PARTIAL_OPERATIONAL_HOLD rather than interpreting missing rows scientifically
execution.scan_access: memory-mapped FITS; save no full-image copies

forced_measurement.expected_raw_image_coordinate: registered target shifted by the fitted positive local detector-minus-Gaia translation, then transformed through the frozen comparison-scan WCS
forced_measurement.measurement: nearest-pixel high-pass residual divided by the frozen detector baseline sigma; high-pass residual uses the frozen detector background_sigma_px
forced_measurement.use: reported contextual evidence only; never by itself promotes, rejects, or closes a candidate

gaia_reference_acquisition.maxrec_hit: operational stop before any comparison pixels are read
gaia_reference_acquisition.proper_motion: rows with finite ref_epoch, pmra and pmdec are propagated to the comparison plate epoch; rows lacking required motion are retained in provenance counts but excluded from the registration fit

injection_recovery.nondetection_without_sensitivity: never interpreted as negative recurrence evidence
injection_recovery.position_shortfall: record sensitivity unqualified for that plate; do not broaden placement rules or change the comparison plan
injection_recovery.run_condition: run only on PRIMARY-registered candidate x plate rows with no strict <=3 arcsec native recurrence; this branch rule is frozen prospectively
injection_recovery.science_pair_reference_snr: minimum of absolute v075 a_snr and b_snr for that frozen candidate
sensitivity_qualified_negative_requires: no corrected frozen-detector peak within 5 arcsec
a finite 90-percent recovery threshold for each of the six combinations of three frozen PSF sigmas and two polarities
the maximum of those six 90-percent recovery thresholds is <= the candidate science-pair reference SNR
injection_recovery.source_implementation: reuse the guarded Order-01 v028 injection functions and frozen detector/method

local_registration.fit: componentwise median translation in detector-minus-propagated-Gaia east/north residuals
local_registration.reference_detector: unchanged frozen detector loaded through the guarded Order-01 v028 implementation
local_registration.sparse_registration: diagnostic only and cannot support a native-pixel recurrence or sensitivity-qualified nondetection
local_registration.window_rule: smallest listed window containing at least five reciprocal Gaia references

native_pixel_recurrence.correct_detector_peak_to_gaia_frame: apply the negative fitted local detector-minus-Gaia translation to every baseline detector peak before target separation is evaluated
native_pixel_recurrence.diagnostic_native_context: PRIMARY local registration, no <=3 arcsec peak, and at least one corrected peak >3 and <=5 arcsec
native_pixel_recurrence.multiple_peaks: report all counts and use closest corrected peak for summary
native_pixel_recurrence.polarity: either detector polarity may constitute positional recurrence
native_pixel_recurrence.selection_role: v079 selection role is provenance only; the same recurrence rule is applied to positive, contextual, and sensitivity-negative planned plates
strict_native_recurrence_requires: at least one corrected frozen-detector peak within 3 arcsec of the registered target

population.source: v078 frozen pixel-followup branch and v079 frozen comparison plan

purpose: Execute the first outcome-bearing native-pixel comparison stage for the 23 prospectively frozen pair-17 survivors. For every frozen candidate x comparison-plate row, perform target-independent local Gaia registration, frozen-detector recurrence measurement, forced target measurement, and prospectively frozen native-pixel injection/recovery sensitivity. Aggregate mechanical candidate states without mutating formal candidate dispositions.

registered_target_coordinate.pre_pixel_guard: reconstructed corrected endpoint separation must agree with the frozen v068a corrected_separation_arcsec within 0.25 arcsec for every candidate
registered_target_coordinate.target_coordinate: unit-vector spherical midpoint of the two individually Gaia-frame-corrected science endpoint coordinates
registered_target_coordinate.translation_sign: v068a shifts are detector-minus-Gaia residuals; each endpoint is transformed to the Gaia frame by applying the negative east/north shift
registered_target_coordinate.v078_target_coordinate_use: v078 target_ra_deg/target_dec_deg is retained for provenance comparison only; it is not the native-pixel recurrence coordinate and v078 outcomes are not rewritten
